'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Jourdan DS Death Star II: Throne Room''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Jourdan]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star II: Throne Room|DS2-D-deathstariithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Matt "Fishfleas" Jourdan
* '''Deck name:''' DS-TRM
* '''Username:''' Fishfleas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
